tools.name: make_worksheet

Each problem comes with its answer, the worked line, and a focus question a grown-up can ask instead of giving the answer. Returns a printable link. Use the same seed to

tools.name: list_worksheet_topics
tools.description: The worksheet topics for each grade (fractions, measurement, two-step problems and more), each with its page.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: The math skills Kizupi teaches in a grade, grouped by strand (number, operations, fractions, early algebra, geometry and measurement, data, logic). Useful for knowing what a grade covers.
